reason: My bookkeeper already runs everything through Jurnal and it works well enough. I'm not moving my villa expenses to a Telegram bot from a small team just to save her a little typing.
objection: Will this bot still be around in a year? If it shuts down, my records and my whole process go with it, and I'd have to retrain everyone.
would_change_my_mind: If it pushed straight into Jurnal or Zoho, and my bookkeeper tried it on our old chat history and found duplicates she had missed, I'd think about it.
